designationHistory.indexText: National Recreation Trails were established by the National Trails System Act of 1968 (Public Law 90-543), which authorized creation of a national trails system composed of National Recreation Trails, National Scenic Trails and National Historic Trails.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.
